title: I-power torsion modules are unchanged by a flat base change that is an isomorphism modulo I
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal such that the ring map $R/I\to S/IS$ induced by $\varphi$ is an isomorphism ($IS$ the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(I)$). An $R$-module $T$ is *$I$-power torsion* if for every $x\in T$ there is $n\ge1$ with $I^nx=0$. Then for every $I$-power torsion $R$-module $T$ the $R$-linear map $T\to T\otimes_RS$, $x\mapsto x\otimes1$, to the base change of $T$ [def-weil-module-base-change] is bijective.
